WITH c AS (SELECT s.customer_region AS region, s.customer_id, SUM(s.net_revenue) AS rev FROM analytics.sales_lines AS s WHERE s.invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND s.invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.customer_region, s.customer_id), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rk FROM c) SELECT r.region, r.customer_id, cu.customer_name, ROUND(r.rev, 2) AS net_revenue_2025 FROM r JOIN analytics.customers AS cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.rk = 1 ORDER BY r.region

WITH q AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS quarter_start, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT quarter_start, ROUND(rev, 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start), 2) AS previous_quarter_net_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM q ORDER BY quarter_start

questions.executed_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS mois, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT mois, rev, LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY mois) AS prev FROM m) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mois) AS INT) AS numero_mois, ROUND(rev, 2) AS ca_net_mois, ROUND(prev, 2) AS ca_net_mois_precedent, ROUND(rev - prev, 2) AS hausse_absolue, ROUND((rev - prev) / NULLIF(prev, 0), 4) AS hausse_relative FROM d WHERE mois >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY rev - prev DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS customers_without_overdue_invoice FROM analytics.customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics.invoices AS i WHERE i.customer_id = c.customer_id AND i.is_overdue) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

SELECT c.segment, ROUND(CAST(AVG(i.days_paid_late) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS average_days_paid_late, COUNT(*) AS settled_invoices FROM analytics.invoices AS i JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.is_settled AND i.invoice_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment
